title: MC Plus
description: This mod adds new features to a lot of stuff in Minecraft. Jungles, beaches, safaris, music and more.
body:
This mod is an addition to the Minecraft world and includes new stuff like:
-More jungle stuff like rubber, bananas, sloths, vanilla, ice cream
-More beach stuff like pirates, volcanic beaches, black sand, seagulls, coconuts
-More savanna stuff like ostriches, termites
-Space stuff like the moon, a space warper, alien, luminite, lunarium, space suits
-Food stuff like cheese, tomatoes, pizza, salt, butter, roasted pumpkin seeds, fried eggs, giant foods, rotten flesh block, fruit trees
-Redstoney stuff like action blocks made from action orbs from a action contructor
-New potions like big potion, small potion, pale potion
